workloads/orders-api/deployment.yaml.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: orders-api
  namespace: orders-api-dev
  annotations:
    box1.org/source-revision: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
    box1.org/build-pipelinerun: box1-ci/onb-orders-api-aaaaaaaa
spec:
  replicas: 1
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  progressDeadlineSeconds: 300
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: orders-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: orders-api
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: box1-golden-path
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: orders-api
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: application
          image: orders-api
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: orders-api-config

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: '1'
              memory: 512Mi
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /q/health/started
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /q/health/ready
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /q/health/live
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 3
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 64Mi

workloads/vm-golden-check/datavolume.yam.content:
# Root disk, imported once from the pipeline-built containerDisk. Not listed in
# kustomization.yaml until the first promotion sets the digest: DataVolume specs are
# immutable, so a placeholder source must never be created.
---
apiVersion: cdi.kubevirt.io/v1beta1
kind: DataVolume
metadata:
  name: "vm-golden-check-root"
  namespace: "vm-golden-check-dev"
  annotations:
    cdi.kubevirt.io/storage.bind.immediate.requested: "false"
spec:
  source:
    registry:
      url: docker://image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000/box1-ci/vm-golden-check-disk@sha256:2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222
      pullMethod: node
  storage:
    storageClassName: lvms-vg1
    volumeMode: Block
    accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
    resources:
      requests:
        storage: 12Gi

workloads/vm-golden-check/virtualmachine.content:
# Halted until the first promotion records the OS image, adds datavolume.yaml to the
# kustomization and sets runStrategy: Always. Later promotions only update the
# box1.org/* annotations (no restart); apply them in the guest with
# `sudo bootc upgrade --apply`.
---
apiVersion: kubevirt.io/v1
kind: VirtualMachine
metadata:
  name: "vm-golden-check"
  namespace: "vm-golden-check-dev"
  annotations:
    box1.org/os-image-digest: sha256:1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    box1.org/source-revision: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
    box1.org/build-pipelinerun: box1-ci/onb-vm-golden-check-bbbbbbbb
spec:
  runStrategy: Always
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        kubevirt.io/domain: "vm-golden-check"
    spec:
      accessCredentials:
        - sshPublicKey:
            source:
              secret:
                secretName: "vm-golden-check-admin-ssh"
            propagationMethod:
              qemuGuestAgent:
                users: [cloud-user]
      domain:
        cpu:
          cores: 2
        memory:
          guest: 4Gi
        firmware:
          bootloader:
            efi:
              secureBoot: false
        devices:
          autoattachSerialConsole: true
          rng: {}
          disks:
            - name: root
              bootOrder: 1
              disk:
                bus: virtio
            # Read by box1-registry-setup.service as /dev/disk/by-id/virtio-<serial>.
            - name: serviceca
              serial: serviceca
              disk:
                bus: virtio
            - name: regtoken
              serial: regtoken
              disk:
                bus: virtio
          interfaces:
            - name: default
              masquerade: {}
      networks:
        - name: default
          pod: {}
      volumes:
        - name: root
          dataVolume:
            name: "vm-golden-check-root"
        - name: serviceca
          configMap:
            name: openshift-service-ca.crt
        - name: regtoken
          secret:
            secretName: "vm-golden-check-updater-token"
